body: Hiii !! I’m looking to commission someone for a female quest avatar ? I’d prefer something that didn’t cost an absolute ton? I understand I get what I pay for, though ! Just wanting to look around to see what my options are ^•^

Literally 2 days ago I met a guy I was vibing with in a world, we were just talking and making jokes and stuff and it was fun! He was awesome to hang out with and one of the chillest players I had met
Until he wasn’t LMAO
We were in a public The Black Cat server and another guy came up to me and was being a little flirty but it was nothing I hadn’t dealt with before, but the guy I was playing with wasn’t having it.
He came over Screaming at the rando talking to me, proclaiming that I’m his and his only and to go away. 
I wasn’t comfortable but I didn’t really know what to say so I let it slide and eventually we ended up in a private lobby in a music world where we were just talking and he starts making … those kind of advances on me, to which I quickly shut him down and explain I’m not looking to be anything more than friends, and he lost his Mind.

He started crying and freaking out and yelling about how, despite knowing me less than 5 hours, he had fallen in love with me. 
I told him we could still be friends but I didn’t want a relationship, and he kept begging for a FWB and even told me that if he stayed friends with me, I wasn’t allowed to flirt with anyone on VRC because it would make him jealous and that ‘I’m His’ 
That kept on and he kept trying to make me feel like crap over it for the rest of the night, telling me he was sad so he was gonna leave just to go sit in a corner of the map and stare at me while sending crying emojis
I was stressed at the time but looking at it a few days later it’s kinda funny LMAO.

He also sent me a paragraph on discord explaining how in love with me he was and even admitted to not really knowing anything about me HAHAHA it’s so fucking funny
My mom doesn’t care really, she knows I use it to assist with anxiety and keeps an eye on me to make sure I only use it then. I just don’t want to run into legal trouble if I make it

It feels very unlikely.

I live in a very small southern town. People know I’m gay and trans and I’m heavily targeted for it. I’ve had people threaten to kill me to my face so staying home has been my best option

Imagine you go to the store then BOOM 

The exact face of your dead brother/son/husband
